old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a partially smoked cigarette resting on a textured surface, likely soil or ash. The cigarette features a white filter at one end and a brown paper wrapper at the other. As the video progresses, the filter end of the cigarette begins to burn, emitting small wisps of smoke that rise gently into the air. The ash at the tip of the burning filter grows larger and more defined, gradually consuming the filter material. The background remains consistently dark throughout the sequence, emphasizing the contrast between the burning cigarette and its surroundings. There is no significant change in the camera angle or movement; the focus remains fixed on the cigarette, highlighting the transformation from a whole cigarette to one that is nearly extinguished.

caption: The video captures a static macro side view of a single cigarette resting horizontally on a dark, coarse granular surface against a near-black background. The tan filter and the filter-to-paper boundary hold fixed positions throughout, while a column of gray-white ash occupies the right end. A burn line between the white-paper shaft and the ash creeps leftward, shortening the paper section and lengthening the ash column toward the left. The ember at this line pulses in intensity rather than burning evenly, flaring to a bright orange-red glow at moments and fading to a dim gray line in between. Thin, faint wisps of smoke rise intermittently from the burn line and drift upward into the darkness. The ash texture shifts subtly frame to frame, yet no flake is seen detaching and falling.
